meta.eyebrow: EX-9 · change record · as of 2 Feb 2031
meta.title: Moving the example reports database to a larger plan needs a ten minute pause on Saturday
meta.lede: The reports database is near its storage limit. This change moves it to the next plan size in one short window. Ticket [r1].
meta.foot: Source: an invented example. Replace every value with your own facts.

summary: Resize the reports database from the current plan to the next one up. Reads stop for about ten minutes while the resize runs. No data model changes are part of this work.

in: Check the nightly report job afterwards
out: Changes to the live orders database

risks.title: Resize takes longer than the window
risks.mitigation: Start early and agree a hard stop time

risks.title: Nightly report job fails after the move
risks.mitigation: Run the job by hand before closing the window

risks.title: Data is lost during the resize
risks.mitigation: Take and test a fresh snapshot first

risks.title: Readers see errors during the pause
risks.mitigation: Post a notice on the reports page

plan.title: Post the notice
plan.text: Put the planned pause on the reports page and in the team channel.

plan.title: Take a snapshot
plan.text: Create a fresh snapshot and confirm it can be restored to a scratch copy.

plan.title: Run the resize
plan.text: Start the resize and watch the status until it says available.

plan.title: Check and close
plan.text: Run the nightly report job by hand, compare row counts, then remove the notice.

backout.title: Trigger
backout.text: The resize is not available by 10:30 or the row counts differ.

backout.title: Action
backout.text: Stop the resize if it can be stopped, otherwise restore the snapshot to a new database and point readers at it.

evidence.test: Resize rehearsed on a scratch copy
Snapshot restored to a scratch copy

evidence.result: Expected to pass, not yet run
